about: Background tracker for the AI prototype list. See tools/proto_status.py.

APP-08.desc: Drafts meeting minutes, stakeholder emails and monthly status reports from rough notes, and keeps each project's decision, risk and action log up to date.
APP-08.name: Engineering Project Writer
APP-08.notes: New build with four sample engineering projects: AI turns rough meeting notes, a received email or the project log into minutes, an email or a monthly status report, lists the decisions, risks and actions it found to add to a decision, risk and action log with a sample 5 by 5 rating and health checks, and falls back to template drafts when AI is off; names and contact details are swapped for placeholders before AI. Steps to productionise and Draft in Outlook added.
